svg.aria-label: Pre-existing code disclosure: Swarm Brain adapts memory semantics and API patterns from the pre-existing open-source projects Sen and mnemotree; neither is a runtime dependency, neither is imported, and neither co-owns the schema. All Swarm Brain code was written during the submission period, June 30 to August 18, 2026.
svg.title: Swarm Brain — pre-existing code disclosure
svg.text: Swarm Brain adapts memory semantics and API patterns from our
pre-existing open-source projects Sen and mnemotree (disclosed; neither
is a runtime dependency, neither is imported, and neither co-owns
the schema). All Swarm Brain code — the domain and application
layers, the CockroachDB backend and schema, the retrieval engine,
the HTTP API, the MCP bridge, the demo application, and the AWS
integration — was written during the submission period,
Verbatim from the Devpost description and the repository README.
One license for the whole repository.
Make the repository public before the form is submitted.
Commit-history note: Swarm Brain began inside the Sen monorepo and was extracted into a standalone repository on 2026-08-05. History was
rewritten only because paths moved; authors, timestamps, messages, contents and topology were preserved, and the original-to-rewritten commit
IDs are published in docs/history/sen-extraction-map.md. Every commit is dated 2026-08-02 to 2026-08-17 — inside the submission period.
